# Request body limit

Reject requests whose body exceeds a size limit.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | `bodyLimit` |
| **Category** | Security |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | text | **yes** | — | Max body size, e.g. 10MB, 512KB. |
